description: Band of Veiled Shadows Level 60 Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Ceremonial Ring - Onyx Idol x 2 - Stone Scarab x 5 - Crystal Scarab x 5 - Cenarion Circle:
name: Band of Veiled Shadows
